items.source: Get the BeanOverrideStrategy for this BeanOverrideHandler, which influences how and when the bean override instance should be created.
items.translation: 获取此 `BeanOverrideHandler` 的BeanOverrideStrategy，它会影响 Bean 覆盖实例的创建方式和时机。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.2.6, in favor of BeanOverrideHandler(Field, ResolvableType, String, String, BeanOverrideStrategy)
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.2.6 起，推荐使用 BeanOverrideHandler(Field, ResolvableType, String, String, BeanOverrideStrategy)

items.source: Uses of BeanOverrideStrategy in org.springframework.test.context.bean.override
Construct a new BeanOverrideHandler from the supplied values.
Support case-by-case Bean overriding in Spring tests.
items.translation: 支持在 Spring 测试中逐案覆盖 Bean。
用于 Bean 覆盖处理的策略。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。
